clause: Format matrix registry + row-law + NRT preservation-blob families [STU-IO-006,STU-IO-007,STU-IO-008]

scope.summary: Implement the normative 47-row format matrix as a machine-readable registry (one row per format family: direction tokens I/EP/X/RT, fidelity tokens preserved/transformed/rasterized/preservation-blob/unsupported, posture NRT/SOX/ADPT) with each claimed direction fixture-gated per [STU-IO-004]. Enforce the matrix row-law ([STU-IO-007]): the matrix is the COMPLETE deduped format surface; a source-registry format not listed is covered by the nearest category row plus the format.unspecified long-tail (row 12); adding a format = adding a matrix row with its five gate artifacts, NOT a new import/export subsystem. Declare the NRT families (psd/psb, ai/ait, idml/indd, Affinity .af family, Figma local-copy family) as highest-fidelity preservation-blob targets per [STU-IO-008].
acceptance_criteria: 47-row matrix registry with tokens; row-law fallback; NRT families declared; directions fixture-linked
expected_tests: test: 47 rows present with direction/fidelity/posture tokens; every claimed direction references a fixture set
test: unlisted format resolves to nearest-category row + format.unspecified long-tail (row-law)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No canonical format surface; ad-hoc per-format subsystems (dedup violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
